scenes.text: Did you know there is a massive fifty-square-mile legal loophole hidden inside Yellowstone National Park where you could technically commit a major crime and get away with it completely?
Under the US Constitution, you have the absolute right to a trial by a jury from the exact state and district where the crime happened, but absolutely nobody lives in this specific rugged wilderness.
Because a local jury cannot physically be formed under these strict rules, a trial becomes constitutionally impossible, creating a terrifying zone where criminal laws simply cannot be enforced.
Lawmakers have known about this shocking legislative glitch for decades but still refuse to fix it, so let me know in the comments if you would ever dare to visit this lawless land!
